parsed_entries_without_pdf_link.title: Idelalisib and Ofatumumab Therapy
parsed_entries_without_pdf_link.text: Idelalisib and Ofatumumab Therapy Regimen Indication 00390a In combination with Ofatumumab for the treatment of adult patients with chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (CLL) who have received at least one prior therapy 00390b In combination with Ofatumumab for the treatment of adult patients with chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (CLL) as first line treatment in the presence of 17p deletion or TP53 mutation in patients who are not eligible for any other therapies

tumour_agnostic_rows.title: Entrectinib Monotherapy – Adult
tumour_agnostic_rows.text: Entrectinib Monotherapy – Adult Regimen 00702b For the treatment of adult patient with solid tumours expressing a neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase (NTRK) gene fusion, who have a disease that is locally advanced, metastatic or where surgical resection is likely to result in severe morbidity, and who have not received a prior NTRK inhibitor who have no satisfactory treatment options

tumour_agnostic_rows.title: Larotrectinib Monotherapy - Adult
tumour_agnostic_rows.text: Larotrectinib Monotherapy - Adult Regimen 00758a For the treatment of adult patients with solid tumours that display a Neurotrophic Tyrosine Receptor Kinase (NTRK) gene fusion, who have a disease that is locally advanced, metastatic or where surgical resection is likely to result in severe morbidity, and who have no satisfactory treatment options

tumour_agnostic_rows.title: Larotrectinib Monotherapy - Paediatric
tumour_agnostic_rows.text: Larotrectinib Monotherapy - Paediatric Regimen 00760a For the treatment of paediatric patients with solid tumours that display a Neurotrophic Tyrosine Receptor Kinase (NTRK) gene fusion, who have a disease that is locally advanced, metastatic or where surgical resection is likely to result in severe morbidity, and who have no satisfactory treatment options
